liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Drums** (2 reviews): The Drums segment runs roughly twelve minutes; The stretch after Drums is described as explosive throughout [11][18]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Reviewer's first Dead show; the opening notes of Casey Jones hooked them immediately [13]
- **Wake Up Little Susie** (1 review): Reviewer was puzzled by a fifties tune in the set until hearing the band play it [16]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Not Fade Away as a standout, agreeing with another listener [15]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks)** (1 other source): Most of Caution and Feedback is absent from the audience tape, so this version ends with Mason's Children [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Wake Up Little Susie**: rare: 9 archived performances [19]
- **Katie Mae**: rare: 10 archived performances [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-02-14.sbd.miller.97644.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 227 min; rated 4.5/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording of the early show's ending is missing an essential portion; All disc changes in the late show are seamless [1][18]
- **gd70-02-14.early-late.sbd.cotsman.18115.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 217 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [2]
- **gd1970-02-14.166928.late.mtx.sirmick.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 141 min [5]. Said about its sound: Room reverb in the audience source was reduced [5]
- **gd1970-02-14.124495.cooper-berger.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 145 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: This audience recording places the listener in the room in a way the soundboard cannot [6]

## Around the show

- The audience tape captures memorable crowd chatter [6]
- The acoustic set from this night is missing from Dick's Picks and every other official release [9]
- As with 2-13-70, much of this show's music was left off Dick's Picks volume 4 [10]
- Reviewer rates this night slightly below the previous night's show, though the music is still quite good [11]
- Dick's Picks volume 4 omits Mama Tried, Hard To Handle and Monkey And The Engineer from this show [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-02-14.sbd.miller.97644.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k) [1]
- **gd70-02-14.early-late.sbd.cotsman.18115.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Dick Latvala passed the unreleased leftovers to David Gans, and two cassettes were aired on a KPFA Grateful Dead marathon [8]
- **gd1970-02-14.166928.late.mtx.sirmick.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by SirMick; source: Matrix mix sbd 80% / aud 20% [5]. Also: Audience source was repaired, missing parts patched, levels adjusted, and edited in iZotope RX10 Advanced [5]
- **gd1970-02-14.124495.cooper-berger.flac16**: taped by Jim Cooper; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jim Cooper; hitachi trq-222 deck nak bx-300 > benchmark adc1 > adobe audition cs6 > tlh flac; transferred & seeded by Rob… [6]
